sources.title: Censo Demografico 2022 - Tabela 9514: Populacao residente, por sexo, idade e forma de declaracao da idade
sources.snapshotRule: freeze exported file and record SHA-256
sources.validation: FAIL_CLOSED: ages 0..99 plus 100+ required; no overlap; age sum must equal declared Total

model.postCensus: extend age-zero daily rate from 2022-08-01 through explicit cutoff; declared approximation

notes: Single demographic source: IBGE Censo 2022 / SIDRA 9514.
SINASC intentionally not used by DC-SYN-01-E1; post-Census dates are declared extrapolation, not observed births.
Uniform day allocation does not model weekday, holidays or conventional dates such as 01/01.
100..105 is a declared technical convention for the open 100+ category, not an IBGE observation.
No remote source is consulted by the synthetic generator at runtime.
